learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion, students can use the most important mechanical components of mechatronics in designs and perform the associated basic calculations.
Furthermore, students are able to carry out product development independently and systematically.
Students master the methods of requirements gathering, problem abstraction, and breaking down the problem into smaller sub-problems by defining the black box.

Students can methodically develop products from needs analysis to production in subsequent courses and in their professional lives, which meet customer requirements and manufacturing technical requirements.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts, preferred numbers and series, tolerances and fits
Connection and locking elements (screws, pins, rivets)
Procedures and methods of engineering work, especially characterized by team-oriented and systematic approach
Abstract thinking in technical functions and structured representation of all sub-functions involved in the overall function
Methods for structured solution search and solution evaluation based on technical and economic criteria
Methods for reliability design to increase functional fulfillment through high component and system reliability to prevent costly recall actions
assessment_rules: The module grade for MECB350 is composed of MECB351 and MECB352 proportionally to the ECTS credits, meaning MECB351 has double the weighting compared to MECB352. MECB351 is a 90-minute graded written examination. MECB352 is a 60-minute graded written examination.
